notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Dagger attached to The Locust God.
The Locust God does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate The Locust God using the Quicksilver Dagger ability by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target player and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
